sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Sector breadth remains narrow with only two all-green groups as Energy dominates leadership, while defensive rotation lifts Consumer Defensive at the expense of a fading Healthcare sector.

Energy continues to anchor market strength, maintaining the top rank with a dominant momentum score of 0.933 alongside all-green performance across all timeframes. Short-term rotations favor Consumer Defensive, which jumped two spots over the last five sessions, as well as Financials and Communication Services, while Technology holds steady in the second rank.

Conversely, market breadth is thin with just 2 of 11 sectors exhibiting broad-based strength. Healthcare is the primary sector losing ground, suffering the sharpest short-term rank decline despite elevated broader momentum, while Utilities and Consumer Cyclical linger at the bottom of the momentum rankings.

## Strength
- **Narrow all-green breadth:** Only 2 of 11 sectors (Energy and Communication Services) are positive across the week, month, quarter, half, and YTD timeframes.
- **Energy leadership:** Energy holds the #1 spot across the board with an unmatched momentum score of 0.933.
- **Top momentum tier:** Technology (0.717, rank 2) and Financials (0.683, rank 5) round out the top three relative momentum leaders alongside Energy.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Consumer Defensive advancing:** Posted the largest 5-day improvement, climbing +2 spots to rank 6 with a 0.417 momentum score.
- **Incremental gainers:** Financials moved up +1 spot to rank 5 (momentum 0.683) and Communication Services gained +1 spot to rank 9 (momentum 0.617).
- **Entrenched laggards:** Utilities remains the weakest sector with a 0.067 momentum score (rank 10, down 1 spot over 5 sessions), while Consumer Cyclical sits at the bottom rank of 11 with 0.283 momentum.

## Divergences
- **Healthcare fading:** Healthcare triggered an early-warning signal, shedding -2 rank spots in 5 sessions down to rank 7 despite a relatively strong momentum score of 0.633.
- **Real Estate slipping:** Real Estate lost ground with a -1 rank drop to rank 8, aligning with its depressed 0.283 momentum score.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and Marine Shipping anchor broad market strength, while materials and mining face sharp short-term pullbacks alongside early signs of rotation into defensive retail.

Energy continues to dominate absolute strength and momentum, led by Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.980, YTD rank 2), Oil & Gas Integrated (0.889), and Oil & Gas E&P (0.844). Marine Shipping (0.937) and Consumer Electronics (0.921) also reflect durable leadership, remaining all-green across all observed timeframes. Meanwhile, broad market breadth remains narrow, with only 11 of 144 groups positive across the week, month, quarter, half-year, and YTD.

Shorter-term rotation highlights a severe drop in mining, metals, and alternative energy, with Coking Coal falling 34 spots and Uranium dropping 26 spots over the last five sessions. Conversely, high-momentum groups like Biotechnology and Business Equipment & Supplies are flashing distribution signals with sharp rank slips, while early-stage interest is quietly emerging in consumer staples like Discount Stores and Grocery Stores.

## Strength
- **Core Leadership:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.980, rank 2), Marine Shipping (momentum 0.937, rank 4), and Consumer Electronics (momentum 0.921, rank 28) lead overall momentum and sit among the 11 all-green industry groups.
- **Persistent Outperformance:** Oil & Gas Integrated (momentum 0.889, rank 8) and Oil & Gas E&P (momentum 0.844, rank 11) confirm broad-based strength across the energy complex.
- **Sustained Durability:** Financial Conglomerates (momentum 0.84), Diagnostics & Research, Health Information Services, and Insurance - Reinsurance maintain top-36 ranks across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Rapid Gainers:** Internet Content & Information jumped 21 spots over 5 sessions to rank 69 (momentum 0.74), followed by Tobacco (+18 spots to rank 40, momentum 0.73) and Consumer Electronics (+16 spots to rank 28).
- **Severe Decliners:** Heavy commodities slumped over the past week, led down by Coking Coal (-34 spots to rank 83), Uranium (-26 spots to rank 101), Other Precious Metals & Mining (-21 spots to rank 99), and Aluminum (-19 spots to rank 88).
- **Momentum Laggards:** Footwear & Accessories anchors the bottom with a 0.058 momentum score (rank 142), joined by Building Materials (0.124), Airports & Air Services (0.124), and Utilities - Independent Power Producers (0.133).

## Divergences
- **Fading High-Momentum Groups:** Despite high momentum readings, Business Equipment & Supplies (momentum 0.64) tumbled 22 spots in 5 sessions, while Biotechnology (momentum 0.72) dropped 18 spots to rank 46. Health Information Services (momentum 0.74) also showed distribution, slipping 7 spots.
- **Emerging Turnarounds:** Lower-momentum, defensive retail pockets are gaining short-term traction, with Discount Stores advancing 13 spots (momentum 0.45) and Grocery Stores advancing 11 spots (momentum 0.40) over the 5-day period.
